overview_description.description: Autotek is a Dubai-based AutoTech company focused on transforming the automotive aftermarket industry through artificial intelligence, automation, and data-driven commerce solutions. Operating under AUTOTEK FZCO, the company develops digital platforms that simplify auto parts procurement, inventory management, and online selling for workshops, distributors, and automotive retailers across the UAE and international markets.Its ecosystem includes an online automotive marketplace, AI-powered VIN and OEM part identification tools, fitment verification systems, and enterprise-grade APIs for automotive data integration. Through products like GridX Connect and aux AI, Autotek enables sellers to automate catalog enrichment, cross-reference vehicle compatibility, and synchronize inventory across channels such as eBay and Amazon. The platform processes millions of automotive data points to reduce incorrect orders, minimize returns, and improve operational efficiency for automotive businesses.
